work.author: William Burgess
work.description: An early study of Shakespeare's scriptural matter. It files the Love's Labour's Lost "world-without-end" phrase among that matter without naming a verse, which is the exact limit of what it supports.
work.title: The Bible in Shakspeare: A Study of the Relation of the Works of William Shakspeare to the Bible
